descriptor: Developer tools for build and deploy

voice.summary: Kernel & Cog sounds like a seasoned sysadmin typing in a terminal: dry, exact and quietly funny. It prefers commands and examples to adjectives.
dos: Show the command rather than describing it
Use lowercase for prompts and imperative verbs
donts: Do not explain what a terminal is
Do not hide the clickable link behind the gimmick

taglines: Tools that stay out of your way
Same build on laptop and in prod
Cache it, log it, ship it
boilerplate: Kernel & Cog makes a build cache, a log viewer and a deploy button that behave the same on a developer's laptop and in production.

microcopy.error: error: command not found. try help

logo.note: A chip nods to the machine room and the cog in the name.
